parties:
Yusuf Mia (Md) ----- Defendant-Petitioner
Vs.
Abdul Jalil Majhee and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 4. It appears that on the basis of an application under section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure filed by the respondent the learned District Judge directed enquiry into the matter and Enquiry Case No. 2 of 1988 was started. In that enquiry preceding all parties were notified including the present petitioner who appeared as opposite party No. 4. He claimed himself to be a purchaser from the original decree-holder for an area of 3.21 acres of land by a registered sale-deed dated 14-9-83. Be that as it may, the allegation of forgery having been made with regard to the records of the Court, the court below rightly enquired into the matter and detected the interpolation and corrected the same.
